newsitem.title: USA: SBC, AT&T end merger talks by phone - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: SBC, AT&T end merger talks by phone - WSJ.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Edward Whitacre ended a possible merger with AT&T Corp in a telephone call to the telecommunications giant's Chairman Robert Allen, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said that Whitacre called Allen on Thursday to tell him SBC no longer wanted to pursue a combination.
On Friday, both men told their boards of directors, the Journal said.
Neither company has ever formally acknowledged that they were in talks to create what would have been largest merger in history, at a potential $50 billion.

The possible deal quickly began to unravel amid disagreements over valuations, the right approach to lobbying Washington and likely regulatory hurdles that would be difficult to overcome, sources said.
